concerns.text: The plan states “something_loader.py streams HF Something‑Something V2; if unavailable it **gracefully falls back** to bundled public‑domain clips” but provides no verified citation for the Something‑Something V2 dataset, contradicting the claim in the Constitution Check table that “No new external citations beyond the FlowNet‑C URL (verified).” This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) because an external data source is used without a verified reference.
